tasks.title: Vite + React + TS project setup with Vitest
acceptance_criteria: package.json declares react, react-dom, react-router-dom v6, and devDeps vite, typescript, @vitejs/plugin-react, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom.
npm scripts: dev, build, preview, test (vitest run), test:watch.
vite.config.ts registers @vitejs/plugin-react and a Vitest config with environment 'jsdom', globals true, and setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts.
src/test/setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom.
index.html has the root div, viewport meta, and Google Fonts preconnect + stylesheet for Newsreader and IBM Plex Sans.
src/main.tsx mounts <App/> inside <BrowserRouter> and imports the global stylesheets.
.gitignore excludes node_modules, dist, and the DEV-19 handoff bundle.
tests: package.json parses and lists react-router-dom and vitest (file assertion)
index.html references the Newsreader and IBM Plex Sans font families (file assertion)

tasks.title: Salon design tokens + global base styles
acceptance_criteria: tokens.css defines :root CSS custom properties for the Salon palette (at least --bg, --surface, --surface-alt, --ink, --body, --muted, --faint, --accent, --gold, --gold-hover, --border), the medium accents, the dark-gradient, the shell/rail sizes, and the sm/md/lg breakpoint values, matching design-reference.md.
global.css applies a box-sizing reset, sets body background to var(--bg), body text color to var(--ink), default font-family to 'IBM Plex Sans', and defines base heading styles using 'Newsreader'.
No hard-coded Salon hex values appear outside tokens.css in later components (documented convention).

tasks.title: Shared mock types
acceptance_criteria: Exports a Medium union type ('film' | 'serie' | 'livre' | 'doc').
Exports an Article interface with id, title, medium, excerpt, cover, date, author, and body fields (body optional), plus a Comment interface (id, author, date, body, isAuthor?) usable by later pages.
Types are pure declarations with no runtime code.
tests: types.ts type-checks and Medium/Article are importable (compile-time smoke via a typed test fixture)

tasks.title: Shared Layout: desktop rail + mobile drawer nav
acceptance_criteria: nav.ts exports the nav model: primary media items (Films/Séries/Livres/Docs → /films,/series,/livres,/docs) and secondary page items (Bilan culturel/À propos/Me suivre → /bilan-culturel,/a-propos,/me-suivre).
Header renders the brand 'Clap et chapitre' with the 'et' emphasized (italic, --accent) and the gold underline mark and tagline.

On desktop Header is a 224px left rail listing primary then secondary nav via react-router NavLink; the active link gets the active treatment (--ink background, cream text, gold dot) and aria-current='page'.
On mobile Header is a top bar with a ☰ button and centered wordmark; pressing ☰ opens a drawer overlay (75% width) with the same nav and a close control; the drawer is hidden by default.
Layout renders <Header/>, <main> with <Outlet/>, and <Footer/>; Footer is a minimal Salon-styled footer.
Responsive behavior is driven by CSS (rail vs top bar) using the token breakpoints; the drawer open/close is React state.
tests: Layout renders the brand and all seven nav labels (Films, Séries, Livres, Docs, Bilan culturel, À propos, Me suivre)
the NavLink matching the current route has aria-current='page'
clicking the ☰ button reveals the drawer nav and the close control hides it again

tasks.title: Route table + placeholder pages
acceptance_criteria: App.tsx defines a <Routes> tree with <Layout> as the shared element and child routes: / , /films, /series, /livres, /docs → HomePage; /article/:id → ArticlePage; /bilan-culturel → BilanCulturelPage; /archives → ArchivesPage; /a-propos → AProposPage; /me-suivre → MeSuivrePage; and a * → NotFound fallback.
Each page is a minimal placeholder component rendering an identifying heading (e.g. an <h1>) so subtasks 02+ can replace the body without touching routing.
HomePage reads the medium from the route (e.g. uselocation/useParams or a route prop) enough to show which medium filter is active, without implementing real filtering.
No page imports Salon hex values directly; they use tokens.
tests: navigating to each route renders that page's placeholder heading inside the Layout without throwing
an unknown route renders the NotFound page
the /livres route renders the Home page marked with the 'livre' medium

out_of_scope: Real page content/layout for Home, Bilan, Archives, À propos, Me suivre (subtasks 02, 04-07).
The real /article/:id article view (owner designs it before subtask 03).
Any backend, real data, or network calls.
